method.sources: Claude Code session transcripts on each agent host, read in place by collector/agents_scan.py. Only timings, counts and token totals leave the host, never prompt text. Daily totals are kept, so history outlives Claude Code deleting transcripts after 30 days.
method.attention: Your attention: time from an agent finishing to your next prompt, capped at 10 min per prompt (beyond that you were away), counted once across sessions and hosts: overlapping waits are one stretch of your time. Per-project figures are per session, so they add up to more.
method.busy: Agent working time: from your prompt through the agent's last activity, with gaps over 15 min cut out. Subagents count as their own agents.
method.parallel: Parallel agents: the average number of agents working at once while at least one was, across all hosts.
method.automated: Automated: sessions started by apps through `claude -p` / the SDK (worker jobs), not by you.
